title: dianthus prolifer var. nanteuilii
intro: Dianthus prolifer var. nanteuilii, commonly known as Fringed Pink, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Fringed Pink include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
